kyoto_icchan_ramen.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen noodles, gyoza and soy-based soups (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_icchan_ramen.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork and chicken soups with chashu and jerk chicken (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_icchan_ramen.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday lunch 11:30–14:00 and dinner 19:00–23:00; Sunday and holidays lunch only; closed Monday (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 11 seats: 8 at the counter and one table for 3; smoking allowed except 11:30–13:30, with an ashtray outside (Tabelog). Reggae on the sound system and a Rasta-coloured entrance that hides the inside (2025 reviews). Just above the Furukawa-cho shopping street off Sanjo, 98 m from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog; October 2025). Opened 23 September 2008 (Tabelog).
kyoto_icchan_ramen.notes: [Ramen · Higashiyama-Sanjo, jerk-chicken ramen to a reggae beat] A tiny, Rasta-painted ramen counter by Higashiyama Station where the house hits are jerk-chicken ramen and a creamy, green-curry-like spicy-coconut ramen (about ¥850–1,100); regular, black and garlic bowls too. Lunch sets add chashu rice and an egg for a little more. Reggae plays, the owner is warm, and it is open late. Cash only; smoking allowed outside lunch hours. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner known as Icchan (reviews); full name not given
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 23 September 2008. Reviewers describe a reggae-themed shop with a Jamaican feel, jerk-chicken and spicy-coconut ramen alongside classic bowls, and a warm owner nicknamed Icchan.

anecdotes.text: A September 2024 visitor tried the spicy-coconut ramen on the strong advice of a local gentleman met at a takoyaki shop, and agreed.
A March 2025 first-timer expected green curry from the spicy-coconut ramen and found it creamy rather than hot.
An August 2025 diner chose the summer tomato cold noodles with avocado on a hot day.

kyoto_bistro_ramaju.gf_detail: Ask. Classic French courses with sauces, pastry-wrapped fish and bread; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_bistro_ramaju.vegan_detail: Not vegan: classic French courses of meat, game and fish with butter sauces (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_bistro_ramaju.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:00); dinner 18:00–23:00 (last order 21:00); closed Wednesday and Thursday (open on some holidays) (Tabelog). Reservations advised. No service charge (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「サービス料なし」). 12 seats, up to 15 for private hire; non-smoking, with an ashtray at the entrance; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). On Takakura-dori north of Oshikoji, between Karasuma-Oike and Kyoto City Hall, 352 m from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog; June 2024). Open since 1990 (September 2025 review).
kyoto_bistro_ramaju.notes: [French · Takakura-Oshikoji, a one-chef classic bistro since 1990] A small, long-standing bistro between Karasuma-Oike and City Hall, where a veteran chef cooks and serves single-handed. Expect classic French with proper sauces: rillettes, roast duck, sea bream in pastry, and wild duck in the hunting season, with Burgundy to match. The ¥3,080 lunch course is a quiet bargain. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per a September 2025 review: chef Hiroshi Ueda has more than 40 years in French cooking alone, trained at the long-established French restaurant Toyoken in Tokyo, and has run Bistro Ramaju since 1990. Per Tabelog’s official introduction: traditional French with seasonal ingredients, classic techniques and versatile sauces, Burgundy wines and game in season, supported by many well-known regulars. A January 2026 reviewer notes the chef manages everything alone.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: classic French technique and versatile sauces to bring seasonal ingredients to life.
chef_bio.specialty: Classic French courses; game in the hunting season.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 lunch guest found the relaxed pace natural, with the chef handling everything alone.
An April 2025 birthday diner had a six-dish course of shrimp and prosciutto salad, roast duck, sea bream and lamb.
A June 2023 visitor tired of kaiseki found the 33-year-old bistro easy to enjoy as a tourist.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ビストロ ラマージュ、フレンチ・ビストロ・洋食、中京区高倉通押小路上ル瓦町555-1 西村良ビル1F、烏丸御池駅から352m、12:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)、18:00〜23:00 (L.O. 21:00)、水木定休 (祝日は営業の場合あり)、サービス料なし、12席 (貸切15名)、禁煙 (入口に灰皿)、カード可。公式紹介: 季節の食材、古典的な技法と多彩なソースの伝統的なフランス料理、ブルゴーニュ中心のワイン、狩猟の季節は鴨などのジビエ、著名人にも支持される老舗。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 1990年から、シェフ Hiroshi Ueda はフランス料理一筋40年以上、東京の老舗 Toyoken で修業、一人で切り盛り、ランチコース3,080円、リエット、鴨のロースト、鯛のパイ包み、仔羊。

cultural_comfort.note: A one-chef room; relaxed pace.

kyoto_imakara_nakajin.gf_detail: Ask. Courses feature fried shrimp, chicken katsu, tempura and gratin; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_imakara_nakajin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses built on seafood, chicken and meat (reviews).
kyoto_imakara_nakajin.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:30 and dinner 18:00–20:30, Monday and Thursday–Sunday; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog). Mainly courses, with occasional à la carte days (September 2024). No service charge (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「なし」 — the English page says a fee may be added). Cash only — no cards or e-money (Tabelog). 8 counter seats; private hire possible; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). Moved to Karasuma-Imadegawa: from the crossing go 20 m north, turn west, fourth door on the north side behind the bicycle parking, 37 m from Imadegawa Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_imakara_nakajin.notes: [Yoshoku · Karasuma-Imadegawa, light Western food the Japanese way] An eight-seat counter tucked behind a bicycle park just north of Karasuma-Imadegawa, run by a couple. The theme is 'Western cooking for those aged 45 and up': fried shrimp is the star, and the courses run through seasonal small plates, gratin, tempura with house uni salt and a feather-light chicken katsu. Lunch and early dinner; cash only. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Owner-chef not named; run by a couple (March 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: moved to Karasuma-Imadegawa and changed format slightly, now themed "Western cuisine for those aged 45 and up", with fried shrimp as the main dish and plenty of tempura and Japanese technique for lighter yoshoku. Reviewers say the owner previously ran a soba shop (November 2022; May 2026) and that it is run by a couple (March 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: light Western dishes that won’t leave you feeling heavy.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 first-timer, sent by another chef, had a tempura of fuki buds and aosa with house uni salt.
A May 2026 diner finished with three pieces of chicken katsu turned into a katsu-don and still felt fine the next morning.
A May 2026 visitor nearly missed the stylish door hidden behind the bicycle parking.

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter, courses, cash only; hard to find.

kyoto_shibaf_namafu_pizza.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the pizza bases are made of nama-fu, which is wheat gluten (official site; Tabelog).
kyoto_shibaf_namafu_pizza.vegan_detail: Ask. Nama-fu itself is plant-based, but the pizzas carry cheese, cream, fish, chicken or duck; nothing vegan is marked (2026 reviews).
kyoto_shibaf_namafu_pizza.hours_raw: 11:00–17:00 (last order 16:30); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Bookings taken, useful at holiday periods (August 2026). Pizzas come with a soup (September 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 25 seats over two floors of a renovated Kyoto machiya, with nama-fu for sale on the ground floor; non-smoking; cards, transit IC and other e-money, and QR (Tabelog). On Rokkaku-dori, about 10 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn (511 m) (Tabelog; August 2026).
kyoto_shibaf_namafu_pizza.notes: [Pizza · Rokkaku, pizza on fresh wheat gluten] A stylish machiya café from an Edo-period Kyoto fu maker, where the pizza bases are nama-fu — chewy, crisp-edged and lighter than dough. Toppings lean Kyoto: smoked duck with Kujo leek and yuzu-pepper cream, mackerel with shibazuke, shirasu with shiso and lemon. A soup comes alongside; buy fu to take home downstairs. Daytime only; closed Tuesday.

roles: Run by the nama-fu maker 志場商店 (official site); no chef named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 志場商店, said to date from the late Edo period, began trading in Mibu and has made Kyoto nama-fu for four generations, building a wide range in answer to Kyoto chefs’ requests; it launched shibaF as a new nama-fu restaurant to make fu an everyday food. Per Tabelog: nama-fu pizza in a renovated Kyoto machiya with counter and table seating and a retail corner.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to explore and widen what Kyoto nama-fu can be.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 family tried mackerel-with-shibazuke and shiso-lemon-shirasu pizzas.
An August 2026 pair, searching for cheese, discovered the nama-fu crust and found it lighter than regular pizza.
An August 2026 diner noted the dough firms up as it cools, a texture of its own.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (shiba-f.com): shibaF KYONAMAFU、京生麩の可能性を探り広げる、京都で生麩を作り続けてきた志場商店が立ち上げた生麩料理専門店、志場商店は江戸時代後期の創業とされ初代が壬生で商いを始め現在4代目、京都の料理人の要望に応えて増えた多彩な生麩 (もち麩、あわ麩、よもぎ麩、柚子麩、実山椒麩、チーズ麩など)、中京区西六角町105。食べログ: ピザ・カフェ、烏丸御池駅から511m、11:00〜17:00 (L.O. 16:30)、火曜定休、25席 (1階カウンター7とテーブル、2階カウンター4とテーブル)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、町家を改装、1階に物販。口コミ (2026年、英語): 生麩ピザ、燻製鴨と九条ねぎの柚子胡椒クリーム、京赤地鶏とポルチーニ、鯖としば漬け、大葉とレモンのしらす、手羽のフリット、スープ付き。

cultural_comfort.note: Picture menu of pizzas; retail fu downstairs.

kyoto_un_son_doux.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: croissants, brioche, pies and cakes; the gâteau nantais uses almond flour but is not described as wheat-free (2026 reviews).
kyoto_un_son_doux.vegan_detail: Not vegan: butter- and egg-rich pastries; the bean-to-bar chocolate is described as only cacao and sugar — ask (2026 reviews).
kyoto_un_son_doux.hours_raw: Tue–Sat and holidays 8:00–18:00; closed Sunday and Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). One person bakes and serves, so items sell out by afternoon (June 2026 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Mainly take-away; 2 seats in a small café corner (Tabelog; September 2026 review). A sliding door, hard to see into, north of Nijo near Teramachi (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_un_son_doux.notes: [Pâtisserie · north of Nijo near Teramachi] A quiet, gallery-like shop where one pâtissier bakes French regional sweets and viennoiserie — gâteau nantais, pithivier, buttery croissants — plus bean-to-bar chocolate. Mostly ¥300–500 a piece; go early, things sell out. Closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 6 June 2024 (Tabelog). Reviewers say one person bakes everything (June and August 2026); a June 2026 diner read that the owner trained at Au Bon Vieux Temps.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 visitor buying caramel was given an ice pack to keep it cool.
An August 2026 croissant fan rated it above those of Kyoto's top-100 bakeries.
An August 2026 reviewer, writing in Japanese, found that day's bakes a little dark and wanted more custard in the far breton.

kyoto_osaji_kyoto.gf_detail: Ask. Rice-koji amazake smoothies are likely wheat-free, but toppings, vegetable cakes, muffins and scones are not described (2026 reviews).
kyoto_osaji_kyoto.vegan_detail: Ask. Amazake made from Kyoto rice and koji with fruit and vegetables; toppings include honey; baked goods not described (2026 reviews).
kyoto_osaji_kyoto.hours_raw: 10:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); closed Monday, or the next weekday when Monday is a holiday (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 16 seats at the café counter at the back of the store; take-away possible (Tabelog; October 2026 review). Inside OSAJI's concept store in a machiya north of Nijo; 7 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_osaji_kyoto.notes: [Fermentation café · north of Nijo] The café counter at the back of skincare brand OSAJI's first concept store, a calm, incense-scented machiya: build your own amazake smoothie from Kyoto rice koji and fruit, with a vegetable cake or scone, then browse the cosmetics. About ¥1,000–1,500. Opened April 2026; closed Monday.

roles: Café of the cosmetics brand OSAJI (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Opened 25 April 2026 (Tabelog) as what an October 2026 reviewer calls OSAJI's first global concept store, combining cosmetics, a product-trial space and the café.
chef_bio.philosophy: A concept store offering drinks and sweets centred on fermentation (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: Unsure what to pick, an October 2026 visitor was given seasonal recommendations and tips on local Kyoto events by the staff.
An October 2026 visitor found the smoothies distinctive enough to divide opinion, but enjoyed choosing bases and toppings.

kyoto_ebisugawa_gyoza_nakajima_donguri.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat gyoza wrappers, fried rice and yakisoba with soy-based sauces (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ebisugawa_gyoza_nakajima_donguri.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork gyoza, chashu, pork miso soup (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ebisugawa_gyoza_nakajima_donguri.hours_raw: 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30), daily (Tabelog; official site). Bookings taken, but may be refused in the cherry-blossom and autumn-leaf seasons (Tabelog); queues of about 20 minutes on busy nights (September 2026 review). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). 31 seats: counter in front of the kitchen and tables; order on a written slip; take-out and delivery (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). The building also houses "ぎょうざ湯", a bath and sauna by reservation only, built by the sauna-loving owner so guests can have gyoza and beer after a bath (official site). 1 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_ebisugawa_gyoza_nakajima_donguri.notes: [Gyoza & fried rice · by Gion-Shijo Stn] A lively counter-and-table gyoza house a minute from the station, frying light, crisp gyoza to order with dark, chewy fried rice — about ¥1,500–2,500 — and a reservation-only sauna bath in the same building. Open daily to 23:00; cash only; English menu.

chef_bio.background: Opened 21 July 2021 (Tabelog). Per the official site: one of three なかじま shops (本店, 団栗店, 西院店); 本店 and 団栗店 each have a reservation-only bath, ぎょうざ湯, which the sauna-loving owner built to enjoy gyoza and beer after a sauna.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner who had given up several times because of long lines got straight in at 20:30 for gyoza and black fried rice.
July 2026 diners laughed at the drawings on the chopstick sleeves, one featuring a celebrity's eyes.
On the last day of Silver Week 2026 a diner waited about 20 minutes outside and noted many foreign customers.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都 夷川餃子 なかじま・餃子湯、本店 (中京区西洞院通夷川下る薬師町652-1)、団栗店 (東山区団栗通大和大路西入六軒町206-1、11:30〜14:00・17:00〜23:00、無休)、西院店 (立ち飲み)、本店と団栗店に完全予約制の銭湯「ぎょうざ湯」、サウナ好きの店主がサウナ上がりの餃子とビールのために作った。食べログ: 夷川餃子 なかじま 団栗店、餃子・居酒屋・食堂、どんぐり会館1F、祇園四条駅から徒歩1分、予約可 (桜と紅葉の時期は断る場合あり)、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、31席、英語メニュー、テイクアウト・デリバリー、2021年7月21日オープン。口コミ (2026年7〜9月、英語): にんにくあり・なしの餃子、京都ポークの餡、黒チャーハン、チャーシュー玉子、焼売、ソース焼きそば、豚汁、冷やし中華、桃のアイスキャンディー、箸袋の絵、伝票に記入して注文、外国人客も多い。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); order on a slip; cash only.

kyoto_kyomachi_stand_wakadanna.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, beef tataki and dashimaki beside ham katsu, garlic toast and fries (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kyomachi_stand_wakadanna.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, beef, dashi obanzai (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kyomachi_stand_wakadanna.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 16:00–23:30; Sat–Sun 13:00–23:30; hours may change (Tabelog). Happy hour until 18:00 with highballs from about ¥200–220 (September–October 2026 reviews). No bookings. Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「テーブル席は席料３００円」 — ¥300 for table seats (a September 2026 reviewer paid ¥330); the standing counter has none. No cards or e-money; QR payments (Tabelog). Standing counter on the left, about 40 table seats on the right; non-smoking, ashtray outside (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). A little south of Shijo on Takakura; 4 min from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; September 2026 review).
kyoto_kyomachi_stand_wakadanna.notes: [Standing bar · Takakura near Shijo] A big, cheerful standing bar with tables to the side, from the いなせや group: ¥220 happy-hour highballs until 18:00, obanzai trios, wagyu tataki and very fresh sashimi for well under ¥1,000 a plate. Standing is free; tables cost ¥300. Open to 23:30 daily.

chef_bio.background: Opened 11 November 2020 (Tabelog). Reviewers place it in the いなせや group (August and September 2026); the group's いなせや is run by Gallant, a Kyoto restaurant operator (kyoto_tachinomi_inaseya).
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai trio; wagyu tataki; happy-hour highballs.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular takes being served a giant "baka jokki" beer as the cue to go home.
An August 2026 diner, delayed by a JR accident, came in starving for wagyu tataki, sashimi and dashimaki — all well priced.
An October 2026 guest who knows いなせや in Osaka found the Kyoto flavours quite different, and dipped shrimp mayo in the tsukune sauce.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京町スタンド 若旦那、立ち飲み、下京区綾材木町188-2、烏丸駅から274m、月〜金 16:00〜23:30、土日 13:00〜23:30、予約不可、テーブル席は席料300円、カード・電子マネー不可、QR 可、カウンター20・テーブル40、禁煙 (入口前に灰皿)、2020年11月11日オープン。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年10月、英語): いなせやグループ、四条から高倉通を少し南、18時までのハッピーアワーで角ハイ220円ほど、おばんざい盛り (明太しらたき、おから、日替わり)、和牛たたき580円、刺身盛り850円、和牛生センマイ520円、だし巻き380円、ユッケ、ハムカツ、海老マヨ、つくねとピーマン、カニ味噌、ガーリックトースト、席料330円だったという声、バカジョッキ。

cultural_comfort.note: Standing counter or tables (¥300); no bookings.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_tsuki_to_rokupensu.gf_detail: Ask. Coffee with toast, sandwiches and croque monsieur (2018–25 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_tsuki_to_rokupensu.vegan_detail: Ask. Coffee, café au lait and hot milk, cheese and sardine sandwiches (2018–25 reviews); no vegan information.
kyoto_tsuki_to_rokupensu.hours_raw: MEMBERS ONLY: Tabelog states the café is now members-only and is not accepting new membership applications. Earlier, membership was open by registering a name (February 2025) or by Instagram message (May 2025). Wed–Sat 12:00–20:00; closed Sunday–Tuesday and holidays (Tabelog). No reservations; cash only (Tabelog). A stay of 1–3 hours cost ¥1,000 with one drink (April 2024). No talking and no computers (Tabelog; 2017–25 reviews). 17 counter seats, up a narrow stair on the 2nd floor of 杉野ビル on Nijo west of Takakura (Tabelog; October 2018). Opened 8 September 2008 (Tabelog).
kyoto_tsuki_to_rokupensu.notes: [Reading café · Nijo Takakura, members only and silent] A book-lined second-floor counter where no one talks and laptops are banned: deep-roast coffee, café au lait and toast or sandwiches while you read. Now members-only, and Tabelog says no new members are being accepted, so most visitors cannot get in. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a café opened 8 September 2008 that has since become members-only and no longer accepts new applications. A February 2025 visitor described an owner devoted to books and coffee who wants to keep the space undisturbed.
chef_bio.philosophy: A quiet space for reading and thinking alone (2017–25 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A November 2024 visitor, after years of finding it closed, asked about membership and was let in.
A November 2020 visitor found it quieter than a music café — even whispering felt awkward.
A February 2025 visitor praised a bookshelf full of titles worth picking up, unlike shallow "book cafés".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、中京区二条通高倉西入ル松屋町62 杉野ビル 2F、丸太町駅から392m、水〜土12:00〜20:00、日月火祝休み、予約不可、会員制 (現在、新規の入会は受け付けていない)、現金のみ、カウンター17席、禁煙、店内でのパソコンは不可、2008年9月8日オープン。口コミ (2017年2月〜2025年5月、英語): 会話禁止の読書のためのカフェ、本棚、深煎りのコーヒー480円、1〜3時間1,000円 (1ドリンク付き)、フルーツサンド600円、カマンベールときのこのサンド、オイルサーディンのサンド、はちみつシナモントースト、カフェオレ、以前は名前の登録や Instagram で入会できた。

cultural_comfort.note: Members only, and Tabelog says no new members are being accepted; only an existing member’s arrangement could get you in. Silence and no laptops inside.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (members-only notice); reviews dated through May 2025.

kyoto_hatsune_zushi.gf_detail: Ask. Pressed, saba and chirashi sushi with soy-sweetened toppings such as anago, and clear soup (2022–26 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_hatsune_zushi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish sushi and a dashi soup (2022–26 reviews).
kyoto_hatsune_zushi.hours_raw: 11:00–19:00 straight through, handy between lunch and dinner (Tabelog; September 2025); closed Thursday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). CASH ONLY — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 15 seats: a 7-seat counter and one tatami room for 6 (Tabelog; June 2024). One parking space (Tabelog). English signs inside (October 2025). On a lane north of Sanjo by the Shirakawa; 2 min from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_hatsune_zushi.notes: [Kyoto sushi · Sanjo Shirakawa, an old couple’s counter since 1935] A seven-seat counter by the Shirakawa where an elderly couple serve Kyoto-style saba, pressed and chirashi sushi all afternoon — the Hatsune set is ¥2,000, Kyo-zushi ¥1,400, and steamed sushi in winter. Open 11:00–19:00 without a break, handy after the Okazaki museums. Cash only; closed Thursday.

roles: Chef (unnamed) and spouse, an elderly couple who run the shop (March and May 2025)
chef_bio.background: Per a June 2026 review: a long-established shop founded in 1935, using rice from Tango in northern Kyoto Prefecture. Reviews from March and May 2025 describe an elderly couple running the counter.
chef_bio.specialty: Saba sushi; Kyo-zushi; winter steamed sushi.

anecdotes.text: A January 2022 visitor arrived at 11:00 before the noren was up; the owner came out and opened up, then offered as much saba sushi as wanted while the steamed sushi cooked.
A December 2024 diner shared Osaka-style and saba sushi with a 91-year-old mother.
A March 2025 visitor, nervous at a sushi counter, relaxed on seeing locals and foreigners already there, and was moved by the nori in the rolls.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司、東山区三条通北裏白川筋西入石泉院町394、東山駅から徒歩2分、11:00〜19:00、木曜休み、予約可、現金のみ、15席 (カウンター7、座敷1室6名)、駐車場1台。口コミ (2022年1月〜2026年6月、英語): 1935年創業、Tango の米、初音 (鯖寿司5切れ、ちらし、吸物) 2,000円、京寿司 (穴子・鯛・海老の押し寿司、巻き、鯖) 1,400円、ちらしと巻きのセット1,400円、鮎・鯖・箱・巻き1,350円、冬の蒸し寿司、瓶ビール700円、年配の夫婦が営む、英語の案内あり。

cultural_comfort.note: Order a set at the counter; English signs inside (October 2025); cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through June 2026.

kyoto_soba_shubo_tokubei.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a menu: udon, tempura, fried dishes, kara-age; the soba blend is not stated (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_soba_shubo_tokubei.vegan_detail: Not vegan: soba and udon in dashi, herring soba, sashimi, yakitori (2026 reviews).
kyoto_soba_shubo_tokubei.hours_raw: Sun–Thu and holidays 11:00–22:30 (last order 21:30); Fri, Sat and days before holidays 11:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); lunch 11:00–15:00; open all year, with changed hours at New Year (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; call for same-day cancellations (Tabelog). Cards, Suica-type e-money, PayPay and d Barai (Tabelog). 242 seats (about 220 per the official site): sunken tatami and table seats, private rooms for 4–20 with a 2-hour limit, groups up to 54 (Tabelog; official site). Non-smoking with a smoking room (Tabelog). Kyoto Station Building East Zone 2F, by the Kyoto Theatre entrance; 1 min from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 1 August 2015 (Tabelog).
kyoto_soba_shubo_tokubei.notes: [Soba izakaya · Kyoto Station Building, a big room by the Kyoto Theatre] A 200-plus-seat soba tavern a minute from the platforms: soba made daily from domestic buckwheat, tempura of Kyoto vegetables, fresh yuba and nama-fu dengaku, with private rooms for groups and plenty of sake. Open 11:00 to late every day — handy before a train. One diner found the soba dipping sauce ordinary.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a soba tavern in the Kyoto Station Building serving soba made in-house daily from domestic buckwheat, with the flour varied by season, and Kyoto dishes; about 220 seats with sunken tatami and table seating and private rooms for 6, 18, 36 and more. Opened 1 August 2015 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: House-made soba; yuba and nama-fu dishes.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner found the zaru soba dipping sauce tasted bought-in, but the soba good enough not to mind.
An October 2026 visitor, expecting little from a station restaurant at a quiet lunch, was won over by the rolled omelette and the kitsune soba.
An October 2026 group drank bottled beer from chilled aluminium cups whose blue line appears as the beer gets colder.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都駅ビル内のそば酒房、国産蕎麦粉で毎日自社製麺し季節で蕎麦粉を変える、旬の京野菜の天ぷら、京生麩と湯葉の揚げだし、120分飲み放題付きの昼宴会コース5,500円、総席数220席、掘りごたつとテーブル、個室多数。食べログ: 居酒屋・そば・日本料理、下京区東塩小路町901 京都駅ビル東ゾーン 2F、京都駅から徒歩1分、日〜木・祝11:00〜22:30 (L.O. 21:30)、金土・祝前日11:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、無休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、242席、個室は2時間まで、禁煙 (喫煙室あり)、2015年8月1日オープン。口コミ (2023年12月〜2026年10月、英語): 生湯葉、生麩田楽、ざる蕎麦と天ぷら、寿司と蕎麦のセット、にしん蕎麦、カレーうどん、釜飯、刺身、焼き鳥、ハイカラセット、昼のセット約2,000円。

cultural_comfort.note: Big, busy station restaurant; walk in or book a private room; tourists and office workers alike (September 2026). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_kyoto_sushi_matsumoto.gf_detail: Ask. Edomae omakase with marinated and soy-brushed fish, anago with sweet sauce, kanpyo rolls (2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_kyoto_sushi_matsumoto.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish courses with chawanmushi and a soup (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyoto_sushi_matsumoto.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 daily; dinner 17:00–23:00 on weekdays, 16:00–23:00 at weekends and holidays; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; same-day cancellations are charged 100%, and phone cancellations are not taken outside opening hours (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料10%」). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 24 seats with a counter and private rooms (Tabelog; August and October 2026). By the north-east corner of Karasuma Shichijo; 4 min from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog; September 2026). Opened 3 April 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyoto_sushi_matsumoto.notes: [Edomae sushi · Karasuma Shichijo, an omakase counter by Kyoto Stn] A calm Edomae counter four minutes from Kyoto Stn, by a chef from an Akasaka Michelin-starred shop: corn tofu, yuzu-scented ikura rice, sea-bream shuto chawanmushi, then nigiri — lunch from ¥9,800, a weekday nigiri course at ¥14,000. The chef chats in English with overseas guests. 10% service; same-day cancellations charged in full.

roles: Chef (unnamed), formerly of an Akasaka sushi shop (official site); speaks English (October 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 京都 鮨 まつもと went independent from an Akasaka shop awarded a Michelin star two years running, serving traditional, orthodox Edomae sushi in a relaxed setting. A September 2026 review calls it a sister restaurant of the one-star Sushi Matsumoto in Akasaka. Opened 3 April 2023 (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner found the chef friendly and chatting in English with overseas guests.
A July 2026 diner liked the ideas but found the masunosuke marinade a little dry and the corn tofu not quite smooth.
An October 2026 family booked a private room so a child could come along to the ¥9,800 lunch omakase.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: ミシュランガイドで2年連続一つ星の赤坂の名店から独立、伝統かつ正統の江戸前鮨、くつろげる空間。食べログ: 寿司・日本料理・海鮮、下京区真苧屋町99、京都駅から徒歩4分、昼11:30〜14:00、夜 平日17:00〜23:00・土日祝16:00〜23:00、不定休、予約可、当日キャンセルは100%、営業時間外の電話キャンセル不可、サービス料10%、カード可、24席、2023年4月3日オープン。口コミ (2026年7月〜10月、英語): 昼のおまかせ9,800円、平日限定のおまかせ握り14,000円、とうもろこし豆腐、カンパチの柚子焼き、柚子香るいくら丼、鯛の酒盗の茶碗蒸し、まぐろ、金目鯛、穴子、かんぴょう巻き、個室、英語を話す大将、マスノスケがやや乾いていたとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: The chef chats in English with overseas guests (October 2026). Book ahead; same-day cancellations are charged in full.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_dairyu_tei_shogoin.gf_detail: Not GF: wheat ramen, gyoza, spring rolls and fried dishes in soy-based sauces (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_dairyu_tei_shogoin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-bone ramen, fried chicken, mapo tofu with minced meat and gyoza (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_dairyu_tei_shogoin.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 12:00–14:00 (last order 13:45) and 18:00–21:00 (last order 20:45); closed Saturday and Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog original チャージ料無し). Cash only (Tabelog). 32 seats at a counter, tables and tatami; non-smoking (Tabelog; January 2024). Rice can sell out late in a session (October 2023; January 2024). In Shogoin near Kyoto University Hospital; 1 min from the Konoe-dori bus stop, 10 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; April 2024).
kyoto_dairyu_tei_shogoin.notes: [Local Chinese · Shogoin, by Kyoto University Hospital] A weekday neighbourhood Chinese restaurant run by a hard-working couple, feeding students and hospital staff: the crispy yurinchi in sweet-sour sauce, a sweetish pork-fat ramen, mapo tofu and gyoza, mostly as sets of about ¥1,000 with ramen and rice. Quick, kind service. Cash only; closed weekends.

roles: Owner couple (unnamed): a man in the kitchen and a woman who helps there and on the floor (September 2024; March 2025)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Chinese and ramen restaurant in Shogoin; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers describe a couple running it efficiently (September 2024; March 2025), sets built by pairing a main dish with ramen and rice (May 2023), and an owner who offers a mini portion or fresh rice to guests (October 2023).

anecdotes.text: An October 2023 guest, told the rice was out, was later asked by the owner if fresh rice — just cooked — was wanted.
A May 2023 diner warns that the set names differ by one word between the version with ramen and rice and the one with plain rice.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 中華料理・ラーメン、左京区聖護院西町18-2、市バス近衛通から徒歩1分、京阪丸太町駅から徒歩10分、月〜金 12:00〜14:00 (L.O.13:45)・18:00〜21:00 (L.O.20:45)、土日定休、予約可、チャージ料無し、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、32席、座敷、禁煙。口コミ (2023年5月〜2026年2月、英語): 京大病院の近く、学生に人気、夫婦で営む、セットは1,000円ほど、油淋鶏 (ミニも)、油淋鶏とラーメンとご飯のセット1,000〜1,050円、豚の脂の甘みのあるラーメン、魚介豚骨ラーメン680円、麻婆丼と餃子のセット、唐揚げ定食、チャーハン、春巻き、ミニ油淋鶏と自家製チャーシューとビールのセット、ご飯が売り切れることも。

cultural_comfort.note: Japanese menu of sets; quick and friendly; cash only.

existence.note: Official Tabelog listing; reviews through February 2026.

kyoto_ki_an_soba_mibu.gf_detail: Ask. The soba is juwari — 100% buckwheat, handmade (several 2026 reviews) — but the dipping sauce and broth are soy- and bonito-based and no gluten information is given; ask about the tsuyu (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ki_an_soba_mibu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the dipping sauce and hot broth are bonito-based, and dashimaki is served (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ki_an_soba_mibu.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–22:00, last order 30 minutes before closing; after 20:00 open until the soba sells out; closed Monday and the second Tuesday of the month (the next day if a holiday) (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); a short wait at lunch (June 2026). Cash only (Tabelog). 12 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Mibu, near Shijo Omiya; 4–5 min walk from Shijo-Omiya or Omiya stations (Tabelog).
kyoto_ki_an_soba_mibu.notes: [Soba · Mibu by Shijo Omiya, 100% buckwheat] A twelve-seat soba shop where a single chef makes juwari soba by hand from freshly ground buckwheat: sweet, fragrant and firm, good even with just salt, with a sharp bonito tsuyu, real wasabi and a thick soba-yu. Try the soba-gaki or tororo soba, and sake in the evening. Some find the noodles a touch dry or short. Cash only; closed Monday.

roles: Chef (unnamed), who runs the shop alone (September 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a soba shop with a sake list near Shijo Omiya; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers in 2026 describe 100% buckwheat soba handmade from freshly ground flour by a single chef (June and September 2026), with more sake to pair in the evenings (July 2026).

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor had assumed the name was read "Ju-an" before learning it is "Ki An".
A seven-time regular, craving something cold in the summer heat, chose Ki An over chilled ramen (July 2026).
After the lunch rush in September 2026, a second-lunch guest finally got the soba-gaki that is hard to order when busy.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: そば、中京区壬生賀陽御所町22-1、阪急大宮駅から徒歩5分、嵐電四条大宮駅から徒歩4分、火〜日 11:30〜15:00・18:00〜22:00 (L.O.は閉店30分前、20時以降は売り切れまで)、月曜と第2火曜定休 (祝日なら翌日)、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、12席、終日禁煙、日本酒にこだわる。口コミ (2026年2月〜9月、英語): 十割そば (挽きたての手打ち)、もりそば950円、大盛り+600円、おろしそば、とろろそば、かけそば、鰹のつけ汁、本わさび、とろりとしたそば湯、そばがき、だし巻き、夜は Jikon などの日本酒、店主一人で営む、麺が短い・乾いているとの声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter-style room; order at your seat; cash only; may sell out after 20:00.

positives: Soba is juwari, 100% buckwheat (several 2026 reviews); the tsuyu is soy-based, so ask.

existence.note: Official Tabelog listing; reviews through September 2026.

kyoto_kyo_no_tsukune_ya.gf_detail: Ask. Oyakodon in a soy-and-dashi sauce, chicken katsu, chicken nanban, kara-age and duck nanban soba; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_no_tsukune_ya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken restaurant — oyakodon, tsukune, katsu and duck soba (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_no_tsukune_ya.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–20:00; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations for dinner only (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR incl. PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog; July 2026). 36 seats: 20 at tables on the 1F and 16 on tatami upstairs; non-smoking (Tabelog). A machiya-style front on Kawabata-dori — the only entrance — with paid parking to the north; 5 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; May 2026).
kyoto_kyo_no_tsukune_ya.notes: [Oyakodon · Kawabata Marutamachi, near Kyoto University] A long-loved machiya-front chicken shop by Jingu-Marutamachi, its walls hung with signed boards: a soft, rich oyakodon under a deep-orange yolk, with fine sansho to shake on, plus tsukune, chicken nanban, katsu and duck soba sets. Packed with locals at lunch. One November 2026 guest found the dashi light and the chicken sparse. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: chicken dishes, oyakodon and nabe near Jingu-Marutamachi. Reviewers in 2026 call it a long-established chicken restaurant cherished by locals and repeat customers, featured in the media, with signed boards on the walls — one bearing a Nobel laureate's name, given the nearby university (May 2026) — and a lore that renowned doctors from the university hospital were regulars (September 2026).

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 visitor spotted a Nobel Prize winner's name among the signed boards on the walls.
In July 2026 a card-terminal fault meant cash only for the day, posted clearly outside so guests could check before entering.
A September 2026 father, worn out after Byodoin and Fushimi Inari, found the chicken katsu set "looked like a golden meadow".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鶏料理・親子丼・鍋、左京区東丸太町8-3、京阪神宮丸太町駅から徒歩5分、入口は川端通側のみ、北側に有料駐車場、火〜日 11:30〜14:00・17:00〜20:00、月曜定休、予約は夜のみ、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)・QR 可、電子マネー不可、36席 (1階テーブル20、2階座敷16)、禁煙。口コミ (2026年5月〜11月、英語): 京町家風の外観、老舗の鶏料理店、色紙がたくさん (ノーベル賞受賞者の名も)、親子丼1,500円 (小鉢と味噌汁付き)、卵黄追加+200円、七味と粉山椒、親子丼と鴨なんばのセット1,700円、ミニ親子丼、つくね、チキン南蛮、チキンカツ (3種のソース)、限定の特製唐揚げ定食、メディアで紹介、京大病院の医師が通ったという話、だしが薄く鶏が少なかったとの声 (2026年11月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the table; dinner bookings only; cards and PayPay.

kyoto_gion_kitagawa_hanbee.gf_detail: Ask. Teas are naturally gluten-free, but the pairing sweets include cakes, cookies and parfaits; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_kitagawa_hanbee.vegan_detail: Ask. Plain teas suit, but sweets and lattes use dairy, eggs and chocolate; no vegan information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_kitagawa_hanbee.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 11:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); Saturday–Sunday 11:00–20:00 (last order 19:30); closed on irregular days; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and common (Tabelog; July and November 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Counter on the 1F, sofa seats upstairs; non-smoking (Tabelog; July 2026). Staff speak fluent English (May 2026). A Gion townhouse over 120 years old; about 6 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; July 2026). Opened 11 January 2018 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_kitagawa_hanbee.notes: [Tea café · Gion townhouse, open into the evening] A hushed, earthen-walled tea house in a 120-year-old Gion townhouse, run by an 1861 tea merchant: the Chayomi tasting of five teas, each with a paired sweet, matcha kakigori, tea parfaits, and sencha brewed at two temperatures; sofa seats upstairs and English-speaking staff. Lovely space; some find it pricey and the pairing cakes uneven. Open to 20:00 at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 11 January 2018, a Japanese café specialising in tea from Kitagawa Hanbee, a tea merchant established in 1861, offering Japanese tea and sweets. Reviewers in 2026 describe a townhouse over 120 years old (July 2026), attentive staff who refill water and adjust the air conditioning unasked, and fluent English (May 2026).

anecdotes.text: In May 2026 a staff member, seeing guests fanning away the heat, offered more water and to turn down the air conditioning.
An October 2026 visitor found the iced teas noticeably weaker than the hot ones, and some pairing sweets too strong for the tea.
A November 2026 couple, diverted from a closed cake shop on Hanamikoji, found the ¥1,900 cake sets hard and not worth the price.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ・スイーツ、東山区祇園町南側570-188、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩約6分、月〜金 11:00〜18:00 (L.O.17:30)、土日 11:00〜20:00 (L.O.19:30)、不定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、禁煙、2018年1月11日オープン、1861年創業の北川半兵衞のお茶の専門の和カフェ。口コミ (2026年5月〜11月、英語): 築120年以上の町家、土壁、1階はカウンター、2階はソファ席、「Chayomi」2,900円 (抹茶、煎茶、ほうじ茶、和烏龍茶、和紅茶の5種に一口の菓子)、抹茶のかき氷 (ドリンク付き)、茶缶パフェ、ケーキのセット1,900円ほど、抹茶のレアチーズケーキ、グリーンティーラテ、煎茶は70度と90度で2煎 (+100円)、茶葉は50g 1,300円から、英語が流暢なスタッフ、値段が高め・菓子が合わないとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: English-speaking staff; booking advised; cards, IC and QR.

kyoto_teppan_yakiniku_kotono.gf_detail: Ask. Teppan dishes with sauces — the house koto-yaki of meat or seafood steamed with cabbage, yakisoba, kimchi fried rice, cabbage omelette, konnyaku dengaku; sauces include a sweet-spicy miso; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_teppan_yakiniku_kotono.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and the shop stresses vegetables, but most dishes are beef, offal, chicken or seafood and sauces are not described (Tabelog; 2024–2025 reviews).
kyoto_teppan_yakiniku_kotono.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 11:30–23:00; Saturday and Sunday 17:00–23:00; L.O. 22:30 (Tabelog). Weekday lunch with a daily set under ¥1,000 (August 2026). Reservations accepted, including online (Tabelog; August 2026). Cards, IC, iD and QR codes (Tabelog). 58 seats with counter and tatami; private room for 20–50; designated smoking area; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). English menu; take-out and delivery (Tabelog). On Shijo-dori east of Horikawa, 5 min from Hankyu Omiya Stn (Tabelog). Formerly called Arata, according to a December 2024 reviewer.
kyoto_teppan_yakiniku_kotono.notes: [Teppan yakiniku · Shijo-Horikawa, lively and good value] A big, cheerful teppan room on Shijo-dori where meat, offal or seafood is steamed with mounds of cabbage on the griddle (the house koto-yaki), alongside yakisoba, kimchi fried rice and cabbage omelette. Weekday lunch sets under ¥1,000; dinner about ¥4,000–6,000. Friendly, attentive staff; solo diners welcome; English menu.

chef_bio.background: Invoice T6130001051569 is registered to 株式会社いろはコーポレーション, of Kita-ku, Kyoto (NTA register). A December 2024 reviewer believed the shop used to be called “Arata” and had eaten at an Arata at Hachijo-guchi. Reviewers praise energetic, friendly staff who notice empty glasses (2025).

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 solo diner was surprised to find other solo diners, including foreigners, at the counter after work.
A September 2025 visitor came for the yakisoba after watching a TV special on it the day before.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京鉄板焼肉 こと乃、焼肉・鉄板焼き・居酒屋、下京区四条通堀川東入柏屋町7、阪急大宮駅から徒歩5分、月〜金 11:30〜23:00、土・日 17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、58席、20〜50名の個室、分煙、車椅子可、英語メニュー、テイクアウト・デリバリー、ベジタリアン対応、適格請求書 T6130001051569 (株式会社いろはコーポレーション)。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 名物のこと乃焼き (牛・鶏・魚介をキャベツと鉄板で蒸し焼き、甘辛い味噌だれなど)、牛すじとウルテ、ハラミ、アヒージョ、焼きそば、キムチチャーハン、キャベツのオムレツ、平日の昼は1,000円以下の日替わり定食、以前は「Arata」だったとの声、スタッフが元気で気がきく。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); solo diners and foreign guests at the counter (April 2025).

kyoto_artisan_teppan_shichijo.gf_detail: Ask. A small-plate teppan course with Italian technique — gnocchi, tartine, zeppole, capellini, ravioli, puff pastry — so most courses contain wheat; meat and seafood plates may be adaptable (2026 reviews).
kyoto_artisan_teppan_shichijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of seafood, Omi beef and Wagyu consommé (2026 reviews).
kyoto_artisan_teppan_shichijo.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:30, dinner 17:00–23:00 daily; irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; guests with children are asked to book a private room (Tabelog); an August 2026 diner confirmed children are welcome. From 11 July 2026 a 10% service charge is added (Tabelog, original ※2026年7月11日以降、ご飲食代とは別途サービス料10％を頂戴いたします。). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 22 seats: 10 at the counter and two private rooms (one tatami for 4, one table room for 8); private rooms need a ¥40,000 minimum (Tabelog; August 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Ground floor of The Park Residence Kyoto Ekimae, 5 min from Shichijo Stn and 10 min from Kyoto Station (Tabelog). Opened July 2025 (July 2026 review).
kyoto_artisan_teppan_shichijo.notes: [Teppan course · near Shichijo, Italian-trained chef] A white, calm teppan counter with two private rooms a short walk from Kyoto Station, where the chef cooks a long run of small plates with Italian technique — gnocchi, capellini, ravioli in Wagyu consommé, abalone, then Omi beef — for about ¥13,000. Good for anniversaries; children in the private rooms. 10% service charge since July 2026.

chef_bio.background: A July 2026 reviewer names the chef as Shinohara, who “trained for three years at a Michelin-starred restaurant in Italy”, and says the chef visited Omi beef producers to choose animals by lineage; the same reviewer dates the opening to July 2025. Invoice T3040001120567 is registered to 株式会社ｐａｎｇａｅａ of Minato-ku, Tokyo (NTA register). A July 2026 couple found the chef very kind and talkative.
chef_bio.philosophy: Italian technique blended with teppan-yaki, one small dish at a time (July 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 guest celebrating a partner’s birthday on the anniversary course added garlic rice and called it exceptional.
A May 2026 family celebrated an anniversary in a private room and praised the timing of the service.

cultural_comfort.note: Counter dining with explanations of each dish (August 2026); children in private rooms; 10% service charge.

kyoto_tachinomi_tsukinokoguma.gf_detail: Ask. Drinking snacks — grilled white liver, crab-miso pasta salad, meat stew, oden, sashimi, charcoal-grilled chicken thigh with yuzu pepper; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_tachinomi_tsukinokoguma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: liver, meat stew, sashimi, crab and oden (2026 reviews).
kyoto_tachinomi_tsukinokoguma.hours_raw: Ground-floor standing bar 15:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00), daily; second-floor tables 17:00–22:30 for banquet courses only, by reservation; open year-round (Tabelog). Standing places cannot be booked (Tabelog). Drinks may be brought when the second floor is reserved (October 2026). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 26 standing places at a U-shaped counter and tables on the ground floor, 8 seats upstairs (Tabelog; September 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). In a renovated machiya down an alley, 5 min from Hankyu Karasuma Stn, near Nishiki Market and Daimaru (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 16 January 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_tachinomi_tsukinokoguma.notes: [Standing bar · machiya off Nishiki near Karasuma] A popular standing bar in a renovated townhouse down an alley, with a U-shaped counter and young, energetic staff: grilled white liver (¥490), a four-snack solo platter (¥790), crab-miso salad, meat stew, oden and lots of sake. Opens at 15:00 and fills fast; the upstairs room is for booked banquet courses only. PayPay or cash.

chef_bio.background: No owner is named in the sources read. A September 2026 reviewer describes young staff running the bar with lots of energy; another was invited by a neighbouring shopkeeper.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 reviewer stopped in after the Omusubi Festival at Yoshida Shrine and a visit to a sake shop.
A September 2026 diner was still thinking about the grilled white liver the next day.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 立ち呑み ツキノコグマ、立ち飲み、中京区貝屋町561、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩5分、1階の立ち飲みは15:00〜23:30 (L.O.23:00)、2階のテーブルは17:00〜22:30で宴会コースの予約のみ、年中無休、立ち飲みは予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay可、1階26・2階8、禁煙、2023年1月16日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 路地の奥の町家を改装した立ち飲み、コの字のカウンター、白レバー焼き490円、ひとり飲み用の前菜4種盛り790円、蟹味噌のパスタサラダ、肉煮込み、もも炭火焼きと柚子胡椒、おでん、日本酒が豊富、若いスタッフが元気、2階を予約すれば持ち込み可。

cultural_comfort.note: Standing counter, no bookings downstairs; solo-friendly platters; PayPay or cash.

kyoto_apollo_plus_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask. A wide izakaya menu — sashimi, Kyoto vegetable salad, mentaiko pasta, homemade gyoza, fried conger eel, agedashi, Wagyu cutlet and sirloin sandwich; no gluten information (Tabelog shop text; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_apollo_plus_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood and meat dishes; the vegetable dishes (caprese, tomato and avocado, agedashi) are not described (2026 reviews).
kyoto_apollo_plus_sanjo.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00 (food L.O. 23:00, drinks 23:30), Tuesday–Sunday; closed Monday, 31 December and 1 January, plus a monthly two-day break (27–28 October and 17–18 November 2026) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; weekend seat requests may not be met; book private rooms early (Tabelog). Service charge ¥390 per person, ¥590 from 29 December to 3 January (Tabelog, original サービス料 390円 12月29日〜1月3日は590円いただきます。); a reviewer lists the ¥390 as the otoshi (August 2026). Cards and QR (PayPay, Rakuten Pay); no e-money (Tabelog). 55 seats over two floors with counter, sofa, tatami and sunken seating; private rooms for 4–6, up to 20 for parties; the upstairs rooms are reached by stairs only (Tabelog; September 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On the 2nd–3rd floors of NEOD Sanjo on Sanjo east of Sakaimachi, 6 min from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_apollo_plus_sanjo.notes: [Izakaya · Sanjo-Sakaimachi, hideaway rooms] A two-floor creative izakaya with sofa corners and semi-private “hideout” rooms, run by a chef who trained at a high-end restaurant: sashimi, Wagyu cutlet in cream sauce, sirloin sandwich, homemade gyoza, mentaiko pasta, plus Kyoto sakes. About ¥6,000–8,000 a head. ¥390 service charge each; closed Mondays and two days a month.

chef_bio.background: An October 2026 regular writes that “the owner and chef, who trained at a high-end restaurant, creates dishes that are simply outstanding.” Invoice T9130002003657 is registered to 有限会社クロスポイント (NTA register). A September 2026 diner found the 120-minute free-drink limit ran out before the food; an October 2026 guest was handed a card slip instead of a receipt.
chef_bio.philosophy: “Uncompromising attention to detail, going beyond the typical izakaya fare” (Tabelog shop text).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 group of four booked a second-floor private room with sunken kotatsu seating for a night out.
A September 2026 diner ordered the grilled conger eel twice.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: アポロプラス、居酒屋・魚介料理・ステーキ、中京区三条堺町東入ル桝屋町67 NEOD三条 2F・3F、烏丸御池駅から徒歩6分、火〜日 17:00〜24:00 (料理L.O.23:00、ドリンクL.O.23:30)、月曜定休、12月31日・1月1日休み、月に一度の連休 (10月27・28日、11月17・18日)、予約可、サービス料390円 (12月29日〜1月3日は590円)、カード・QR可、55席 (カウンター、ソファ、座敷、掘りごたつ)、個室4〜6名、20名までの宴会、禁煙、適格請求書 T9130002003657 (有限会社クロスポイント)。店の紹介: 刺身の盛り合わせ、京野菜のサラダ、明太子パスタ、自家製餃子、Ozeki の純米大吟醸生原酒の樽、京都と全国の地酒。口コミ (2026年、英語): 高級店で修業した店主兼料理人、黒毛和牛のカツとクリームソース3,900円、カプレーゼ990円、揚げ出し豆腐660円、穴子の唐揚げ、サーロインサンド、半個室が隠れ家のよう、個室へは階段のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Private and semi-private rooms by stairs only; ¥390 service charge; book ahead at weekends.
